messages:
maria (support): Hey team, customer reported chat streams cutting out mid-response ~50% through; they see partial final token. Happening across our Hosted API and their app behind Cloudflare + ALB.

maria (support): client stack: browser fetch EventSource -> Cloudflare -> ALB -> our origin. Customer attached client console: "EventSource.onerror fired, readyState=2" and server logs show request completed but with fewer tokens emitted.

jess (customer success): Customer is on dedicated plan, billing spike when they retry. They want a repro and root cause. Escalating to runtime + sre.

devon (eng-sre): Can you paste the ALB access logs and any CF Ray ID? Also need origin application logs around the stream session id.

maria (support): ALB log snippet: 
```
request_time: 520.213 elb_status_code: 504 target_status_code: -
client: 52.12.34.56 user_agent: Mozilla/5.0
"GET /v1/streams/chat/stream?id=abc123" 200 0 0
```
Cloudflare returned 524 to client in some cases. Ray: 7a1b2c3d4e5f

tony (eng-runtime): ALB 504/524 usually means idle timeout between ALB and origin or CF waiting for origin. What is our ALB idle timeout? by default it's 60s. Long-running SSE should keep sending chunks. Do we send keepalive heartbeats?

maria (support): Customer says our server emits small keepalive chunks every 45s, but they still see stalls and then client reconnect.

devon (eng-sre): 45s keepalive may be within ALB idle windows but Cloudflare's own timeouts & buffering can aggragate. CF will buffer if it thinks response is not streaming or if certain headers are missing. Are we setting Transfer-Encoding: chunked and not sending Content-Length? Also need Connection: keep-alive/upgrade bits.

tony (eng-runtime): Runtime sends chunked frames and flushes after each token batch. Example SSE headers we set: 
```
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Cache-Control: no-cache
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
X-Accel-Buffering: no
```
We do not set explicit Connection header (managed by proxies).

devon (eng-sre): Cloudflare sometimes buffers when it sees gzip on the response or when response size < some threshold and no explicit streaming hints. Try `Cache-Control: no-transform` and `X-Accel-Buffering: no` or `Surrogate-Control: no-store`. Also CF will escalate to 524 if origin doesn't send bytes for 100s.

maria (support): Customer provided a client repro curl command that intermittently cuts: 
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.example.com/v1/streams/chat/stream?id=abc123"
```
They see stream stop after ~70s then client reconnects.

devon (eng-sre): Can we check origin nginx/proxy buffering settings? If nginx has proxy_buffering on, it may absorb small writes and flush later, leading to idle gaps. Need `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on; proxy_set_header Connection '';`

tony (eng-runtime): Our origin runs Envoy in front of the runtime service on ECS. Envoy uses HTTP/1.1 with proper flushing, but we had a recent change to enable connection pooling that may have set `tcp_keepalive` behavior differently. I'll pull traces.

sre-bot: New log search created: streams:stream-id=abc123, time=[4132109000 TO 4132110200]. Results: 12 partial streams, 3 full streams, 5 aborted by client error.

devon (eng-sre): Found pattern: when Cloudflare -> ALB path uses HTTP/2 between CF and ALB, ALB may terminate and open HTTP/1.1 to origin; if there's an early TLS re-neg or half-close from client, some implementations can drop mid-chunk.

maria (support): Customer also saw 401 auth fails on replays when client attempts to reconnect quickly; token rotation TTL is 30s so reconnects that happen after token expiry lead to billing failures. They see a billing duplicate on retries.

jess (customer success): That explains the billing spike. They need a mitigation: either longer token TTL or client exponential backoff with stateful resume.

tony (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigation suggestions: 
- Increase ALB idle timeout to 300s for streaming endpoints.
- Ensure we emit heartbeat bytes every 20s instead of 45s.
- Add `Cache-Control: no-transform` and `Surrogate-Control: no-store` headers.
- For Envoy/nginx: disable proxy buffering and ensure flush after writes.
- Suggest customer set Cloudflare to "Bypass cache" for the route or enable Argo Tiered caching off for streaming endpoints.

devon (eng-sre): Repro steps we've used locally: 
1) Run a small server: `python -m http.server` is not sufficient. Use: 
```
node server.js // simple SSE that emits a dot every 20s
```
2) Put Cloudflare in front and ALB config with 60s idle timeout.
3) Curl with `-N` and observe disconnect after ~60-100s depending on buffering.

maria (support): Customer asked for a concrete config snippet for nginx they can add in front of their client: 
```
location /v1/streams/ {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_cache off;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  chunked_transfer_encoding on;
  proxy_set_header Connection "";
  add_header Cache-Control "no-transform, no-store";
}
```
They will try that on their ingress.

devon (eng-sre): For ALB: set `IdleTimeoutSeconds` in the target group to 300. For Cloudflare: make sure `Origin Buffering`/`Response Buffering` is disabled for the route (page rules or worker bypass).

tony (eng-runtime): We'll also add server-side changes: emit a 1-byte heartbeat `:\n` every 15-20s, and add `X-Stream-Partial: true` to responses to signal streaming. We'll test with CF + ALB in staging.

maria (support): I've shared the above mitigation steps with the customer and asked for their ALB config + CF settings. They will test nginx ingress change today and report back.

jess (customer success): I'll coordinate a billing adjustment if retries caused overage while we investigate. Please tag me when we confirm root cause. :pray:

devon (eng-sre): I'll run an A/B in staging with ALB idle 60 vs 300 and CF buffering toggled to quantify reliability. Will post results here.

tony (eng-runtime): Posting repro notes and test script in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/sse-repro-4132109876 (internal).

maria (support): Thanks all — assigning follow-ups: devon (env+alb test), tony (runtime heartbeat + header tweak), jess (billing/customer comm). I will update the ticket after customer's ingress test. :thumbsup:

maria (support): Update 30m later — customer applied nginx `proxy_buffering off` and reports streams no longer disconnecting in their environment. They still want us to confirm origin-side fixes to avoid recurrence.
